messages:
sophie: Heads-up: Ravenwood Health wants to run a short POC. They plan to test a new variant (ravenwood-16b-slim) for clinician chat + long-context embeddings. They specifically asked: can we onboard this variant and whats the timeline/cost? Also PHI involved.

kai: ravenwood-16b-slim not in our catalog. We can onboard. Need artifacts (HF or s3), tokenizer files, sample prompts (~1k), max_context, license, and target latency SLO. Also confirm if embeddings will be stored/indexed.

andrew: ML/infra note: slim -> likely quantized. We should prepare q4_k and q5_k candidates and run perf on A100/H100. If they need >16k/32k context, KV cache behavior and memory per token change GPU selection. Ask for a few long-doc samples.

mina: Security: PHI requires Dedicated or Private (BAA). Need DPO contact, data flow diagram, and confirmation whether embeddings contain PHI. If embeddings index PHI, require encrypted-at-rest indices, KMS, and RBAC. Legal addendum for Private/BAA is ~2-3 weeks — call that potential blocker.

billing-bot: Pricing note: hosted list for ~100M gen + ~5-10M embed tokens/month will be sizable. Two options: (1) committed Dedicated capacity with monthly commit, (2) mixed routing (embeddings hosted, generation on Dedicated). I can sketch a committed vs hosted comparison once we have peak concurrent streams and avg tokens/response.

perf-bot: Suggested onboarding steps: 1) artifact + tokenizer + 1k prompts; 2) tokenizer roundtrip + edge cases; 3) smoke forward pass; 4) quantization candidates + perf sweep; 5) safety/quality evals (clinical extraction); 6) if PHI -> Private/Dedicated + KMS; 7) canary + SLA.

deploy-bot: model-upload: artifact uploaded, awaiting checksum verification.

sophie: Customer asked if validation can be done in 5 business days after artifact handoff. Can we commit to that? Also they asked for a short tokenizer check snippet to run locally.

kai: Basic checks: 3 business days for tokenizer + perf smoke if artifacts are clean. Full quality + safety eval adds ~2 days. If we must tune for 32k context add ~3 days. Best case 5 business days, realistic 8. Legal/BAA could push timeline.

andrew: Tokenizer check to send them:
```
python -c "from transformers import AutoTokenizer; t=AutoTokenizer.from_pretrained('path/to/tokenizer'); s=open('samples.txt').read().splitlines()[:200]; ids=[t(x)['input_ids'] for x in s]; print(sum(len(i) for i in ids))"
```
And a tiny forward smoke test:
```
python -c "import torch; from model_loader import load_model; m=load_model('path/to/model'); x=torch.randint(0,32000,(1,128)); print(m(x).shape)"
```
These catch tokenizer mismatches and missing weights.

sophie: Great. I'll request artifacts, 1k prompts, a couple long-docs, peak concurrent streams and avg token/response. Ill also upload their security questionnaire to the deal binder.

mina: Also add: retention policy for embeddings, who can access indices, and whether they will export indices outside the account. Add to the questionnaire.

billing-bot: Once peak rps and avg seq length are in, Ill produce a hosted vs committed cost sketch.

perf-bot: I can own the initial quant/perf sweep — please provide a presigned s3 link (read-only). Ill post a short perf matrix and suggested GPU/quant config.

sophie: Thanks — scheduling a sync with Ravenwood for Friday. Ill keep the team posted.

deploy-bot: artifact checksum OK, queued for perf job.
